per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall provide a response time of less than 5 seconds for small management tasks such as adding a student or updating a roster.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The response time of general student management tasks shall take no longer than 5 seconds and the response time of schedule generation shall take no longer than 30 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall support up to 10 concurrent users during peak hours (9 AM–5 PM) without significant performance degradation.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall cater to 10 simultaneous users from 9am to 5pm.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall provide role-based access control (RBAC) to restrict access to sensitive student information based on user roles.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: Only authorized users shall have access to students' personal information.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall comply with the organization’s information policy for protecting private information, including controlled access, encryption where required, and minimal exposure of personal identifiers.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The system shall protect private information in accordance with the organization's information policy.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall maintain an audit log of changes made to schedules and student data, including who made the change, what was changed, and when it was changed.
The system shall provide an intuitive user interface with minimal clicks to perform common tasks, clear error messages, and predictable workflows.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall be intuitive to the Program Administrators/Nursing Staff Members.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall perform basic integrity checks to ensure data consistency, such as preventing overlapping dates, ensuring required fields are present, and preventing duplicate assignments.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall have basic data integrity checking to reduce the possibility of incorrect or invalid data being introduced.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall be reliable during working hours (9 AM–5 PM) with a target uptime of 95%.
The system shall be maintainable for at least 5 years to support multiple cohorts, accreditation cycles, and curriculum changes.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall be expected to manage the nursing program curriculum and class/clinical scheduling for a minimum of 5 years.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall be scalable to support future curriculum updates and additional cohorts.
The system shall include routine backups and a disaster recovery plan to restore data to a recent state in case of corruption.
